scope: axe 结构规则子集 (jsdom, no layout/rendering)

disabledRules.reason: jsdom has no rendering engine: computed colours come from a partial CSS cascade with no layout or painting, so contrast ratios are not trustworthy. Needs a real browser.
Same jsdom limitation as color-contrast (AAA variant of the same check).
Distinguishing links from surrounding text depends on computed colour/underline rendering that jsdom cannot reproduce faithfully.
Depends on media-query evaluation against a real viewport/device orientation; jsdom reports a fixed dummy viewport.
